•
Basilea, CH
•
Tempo pieno
•
Perpetuo
Il loro ruolo
Come specialista nelle transazioni di pagamento presso Bank J. Safra Sarasin, supporterete il nostro team in una vasta gamma di attività e riceverete l'opportunità di svilupparsi ulteriormente in vari settori di responsabilità.
I loro compiti
• Chiarificazione delle operazioni di pagamento con enti interni e banche nazionali e straniere
• Elaborazione dei pagamenti in entrata e in uscita dei nostri clienti internazionali
• Elaborazione di collezioni di check-in e carte di credito e carte Maestro
• Consultare gli uffici interni e i nostri rappresentanti del servizio clienti in Svizzera e in tutte le nostre sedi internazionali nel campo delle transazioni di pagamento, dei controlli e delle carte
• Prontezza per incarichi occasionali in vacanze (1 a 2 volte all'anno) regolarmente con altri compagni di squadra
• Vice incarichi a Kasse Basel, alternati ad altri compagni di squadra
Il tuo profilo
• Istruzione commerciale (o.o.)
• Conoscenza del settore nel settore delle transazioni di pagamento
• Eccellente conoscenza Microsoft Office, conoscenza Avaloq è un vantaggio
• Metodi di lavoro avanzati e strutturati e un elevato orientamento del cliente
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborare in un team e con vari stakeholder
• Rapida comprensione e capacità di riconoscere le connessioni
• Alta consapevolezza della qualità e della responsabilità e grande disponibilità ad imparare e motivare
• Buona conoscenza in tedesco e inglese, nella parola e nella scrittura
I tuoi vantaggi
•
Il pensiero imprenditoriale in una banca a conduzione familiare
•
Sede centrale in Svizzera
•
Servizi assicurativi eccellenti forniti dalla banca
•
Contributo all'assicurazione sanitaria e all'assegno alimentare
•
Strategia di crescita globale e ambiente stabile
•
Proposta competitiva
Informazioni su di noi
Come banca privata sostenibile leader, offriamo servizi di consulenza dinamica e individuale e gestione patrimoniale a clienti privati e istituzionali. Il nostro successo dipende dall'entusiasmo e dall'impegno dei nostri dipendenti e valutiamo ogni persona con la loro competenza unica, le qualifiche professionali e le competenze sociali.
Abbiamo operato con successo in 30 sedi in tutto il mondo da oltre 180 anni e offriamo ai nostri dipendenti l'opportunità di partecipare al nostro successo. I nostri dipendenti sono la nostra risorsa più preziosa. Siamo orgogliosi della nostra cultura unica, che promuove l'imprenditorialità ed è caratterizzata da un alto spirito di squadra e dall'atteggiamento positivo di ogni individuo. Unisciti al nostro team internazionale e partecipa al prossimo capitolo del Gruppo J. Safra Sarasin.

Specialist/in payment transactions
•
Basel, CH
•
Full time
•
Perpetual
Their role
As a specialist in payment transactions at Bank J. Safra Sarasin, you will support our team in a wide range of activities and receive the opportunity to further develop in various areas of responsibility.
Their tasks
• Clarification of payment transactions with internal bodies and domestic and foreign banks
• Processing of incoming and outgoing payments of our international customers
• Processing of check-in collections as well as credit cards and Maestro cards
• Advising internal offices and our customer service representatives in Switzerland and at all our international locations in the area of payment transactions, checks and cards
• Readiness for occasional assignments on holidays (1 to 2 times per year) on a regular basis with other teammates
• Deputy assignments at Kasse Basel, alternately with other teammates
Your profile
• Commercial education (o.o.)
• In-depth industry knowledge in the field of payment transactions
• Excellent Microsoft Office knowledge, Avaloq knowledge is an advantage
• Freight forward and structured working methods as well as high customer orientation
• Ability to work independently and collaborate in a team and with various stakeholders
• Quick comprehension and ability to recognize connections
• High awareness of quality and responsibility as well as great willingness to learn and motivation
• Good knowledge in German and English, in word and writing
Your Benefits
•
Entrepreneurial thinking in a family-run bank
•
Central office locations throughout Switzerland
•
Excellent insurance services provided by the bank
•
Contribution to health insurance and food allowance
•
Global growth strategy and stable environment
•
Competitive bid
About us
As a leading sustainable private bank, we offer dynamic and individual advisory services and asset management to private and institutional clients. Our success depends on the enthusiasm and commitment of our employees and we value each person with their unique expertise, professional qualifications and social competence.
We have been operating successfully at 30 locations worldwide for more than 180 years and offer our employees the opportunity to be part of our success. Our employees are our most valuable asset. We are proud of our unique culture, which promotes entrepreneurship and is characterized by a high team spirit and the positive attitude of each individual. Join our international team and become part of the next chapter of the J. Safra Sarasin Group.

•
Basel, CH

Ihre Rolle
Als Fachspezialist/in Zahlungsverkehr bei der Bank J. Safra Sarasin unterstützen Sie unser Team bei vielseitigen Tätigkeiten und erhalten die Möglichkeit, sich in verschiedenen Aufgabengebieten weiterzuentwickeln.
Ihre Aufgaben
• Abklärungen von Zahlungsverkehrstransaktionen mit internen Stellen sowie in- und ausländischen Banken
• Abwicklungen von ein- und ausgehenden Zahlungen unserer internationalen Kundschaft
• Bearbeitung von Checkinkassos sowie Kreditkarten und Maestro Karten
• Beratung von internen Stellen sowie unserer Kundenbetreuer in der Schweiz und an allen unseren internationalen Standorten im Bereich Zahlungsverkehr, Checks und Karten
• Bereitschaft für gelegentliche Einsätze an Feiertagen (1 bis 2 x pro Jahr) im Turnus mit anderen Teamkollegen
• Stellvertretende Einsätze an der Kasse Basel, abwechselnd mit anderen Teamkollegen
Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (o. ä)
• Fundierte Branchenkenntnisse im Bereich Zahlungsverkehr
• Ausgezeichnete Microsoft Office Kenntnisse, Avaloq-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil
• Speditive und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Kundenorientierung
• Fähigkeit zum selbstständigen Arbeiten sowie zur Zusammenarbeit im Team und mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern
• Schnelles Auffassungsvermögen und Fähigkeit, Zusammenhänge zu erkennen
• Hohes Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie grosse Lernbereitschaft und Motivation
• Gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, in Wort und Schrift
Ihre Benefits
•
Unternehmerisches Denken in einer familiengeführten Bank
•
Zentrale Bürostandorte in der ganzen Schweiz
•
Ausgezeichnete Versicherungs-leistungen von der Bank getragen
•
Beitrag zur Krankenversicherung und Essenszulage
•
Globale Wachstumsstrategie und stabiles Umfeld
•
Wettbewerbsfähiges Angebot
Über uns
Als führende nachhaltige Privatbank bieten wir dynamische und individuelle Beratungsdienstleistungen und Vermögensverwaltung für private und institutionelle Kunden. Unser Erfolg hängt von der Begeisterung und dem Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden ab und wir schätzen jede Person mit ihrem einzigartigen Fachwissen, ihren beruflichen Qualifikationen und ihrer sozialen Kompetenz.
Wir sind seit mehr als 180 Jahren an 30 Standorten weltweit erfolgreich tätig und bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden die Chance, Teil unseres Erfolgs zu sein. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind unser wertvollstes Kapital. Wir sind stolz auf unsere einzigartige Kultur, die Unternehmertum fördert und von einem hohen Teamgeist sowie der positiven Einstellung jedes Einzelnen geprägt wird. Schliessen Sie sich unserem internationalen Team an und werden Sie Teil des nächsten Kapitels der J. Safra Sarasin Gruppe.

En tant que première banque privée durable, nous offrons aux clients privés et institutionnels des services de conseil et de gestion d'actifs dynamiques et individuels. Notre succès dépend de l'enthousiasme et de l'engagement de nos employés et nous apprécions chaque personne avec son expertise unique, ses qualifications professionnelles et sa compétence sociale.
Nous opérons avec succès dans 30 endroits du monde entier depuis plus de 180 ans et offrons à nos employés la possibilité de participer à notre succès. Nos employés sont notre atout le plus précieux. Nous sommes fiers de notre culture unique, qui favorise l'entrepreneuriat et se caractérise par un esprit d'équipe élevé et l'attitude positive de chaque individu. •
Basilea, CH

Il tuo ruolo
Come Specialista delle Operazioni del Tesoro presso Bank J. Safra Sarasin si fa parte di un ambiente di gruppo unico in cui la collaborazione interdivisionale interna e internazionale incontra l'impatto globale. Come membro chiave di un piccolo e agile team, guiderai operazioni di tesoreria dinamiche che vanno da Cash-Management, FX, Money Markets, Repos e Securities Lending & Borrowing (SLB) a Gestione Collaterale. Oltre a questo, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella salvaguardia dei nostri cash-balance attraverso il monitoraggio preciso e la riconciliazione delle posizioni attive nei mercati internazionali.
Le tue responsabilità
• Supporto del nostro principale banco di trading per tutti i compiti relativi al Tesoro
• Eseguire e gestire operazioni collaterali end-to-end, incluse prenotazioni, pagamenti e report
• Gestire il ciclo di vita completo di tasso di interesse Swaps (IRS), Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS), e Credit Default Swaps (CDS)
• Oversee OTC Derivatives rischio processi di riconciliazione e fornire report tempestivi sui controlli normativi e indicatori aziendali critici per gli stakeholder interni
• Analizzare e cancellare le discrepanze di riconciliazione eccezionali fino a quando completamente risolto
• Promuovere la collaborazione cooperativa, orientata agli obiettivi con i team di Operazioni interne e le divisioni di business in tutta la Svizzera e i mercati internazionali
• Assistere il Capo Dipartimento con la gestione di progetti chiave e incarichi ad-hoc urgenti
Il tuo profilo
• Istruzione professionale in economia o affari o apprendistato completato all'interno di una società di servizi finanziari
• Minimo da 3 a 5 anni di esperienza nel Tesoro
• Competenze sonore interpersonali abbinate ad un'elevata motivazione e flessibilità per lavorare in un ambiente emozionante, stimolante e dinamico e la disponibilità a contribuire alla nostra cultura di squadra
• Capacità di organizzare e priorizzare il proprio lavoro
• Assegnazioni occasionali in giorni festivi svizzeri in alternanza con colleghi di squadra
• Competenze a Trioptima, Markitwire e Avaloq è un vantaggio ma non un must
• È richiesta la fluidità in inglese e tedesco

•
Sede centrale per uffici in Svizzera
•
Oltre la copertura assicurativa media a carico della banca
•
Contributo all'assicurazione malattia e all'indennità di pasto

Strategia di crescita globale e ambiente stabile
•

Informazioni su di noi
Come banca privata sostenibile leader, offriamo servizi dinamici e personalizzati in consulenza di investimento e gestione patrimoniale per clienti privati e istituzionali.
Il nostro successo dipende dall'entusiasmo e dall'impegno dei nostri dipendenti e apprezziamo ogni persona con la loro competenza tecnica unica, le qualifiche professionali e le competenze sociali.
Lavoriamo con successo per oltre 180 anni in 30 sedi in tutto il mondo e offriamo ai nostri dipendenti la possibilità di partecipare al nostro successo.
I nostri dipendenti sono il nostro patrimonio più prezioso, siamo orgogliosi della nostra cultura unica che promuove l'imprenditorialità ed è alimentato da un alto spirito di squadra e
l'atteggiamento positivo di ogni individuo. Partecipa al nostro team internazionale e partecipa al prossimo capitolo del Gruppo J. Safra Sarasin.

Treasury Operations Specialist
•
Basel, CH
•
Full-time
•
Unlimited
Your Role
As Treasury Operations Specialist at Bank J. Safra Sarasin you are part of a unique group environment where domestic and international cross-divisional collaboration meets global impact. As a key member of a small, agile team, you will drive dynamic Treasury operations ranging from Cash-Management, FX, Money Markets, Repos, and Securities Lending & Borrowing (SLB) to Collateral Management. Beyond this, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our cash-balances through the precise monitoring and reconciliation of active positions across international markets.
Your Responsibilities
• Support of our main trading desk for all Treasury related tasks
• Execute and manage end-to-end collateral operations, including bookings, payments, and reporting
• Manage the full lifecycle of Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS), and Credit Default Swaps (CDS)
• Oversee OTC Derivatives risk reconciliation processes and deliver timely reports on regulatory controls and critical business indicators to internal stakeholders
• Analyze and clear outstanding reconciliation discrepancies until fully resolved
• Foster cooperative, goal-oriented collaboration with internal Operations teams and business divisions across Switzerland and international markets
• Assist the Department Head with the management of key projects and urgent ad-hoc assignments
Your Profile
• Professional education in business or economics or completed apprenticeship within a financial services firm
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Treasury
• Sound interpersonal skills paired with a high motivation and flexibility to work in an exciting, challenging and dynamic environment and willingness to contribute to our team culture
• Ability to organize and prioritize your own work
• Occasional assignments on Swiss bank holidays in alternation with team colleagues
• Skills in Trioptima, Markitwire and Avaloq is an advantage but not a must
• Fluency in English and German is required
Your Benefits
•
Entrepreneurial spirit in a family owned bank
•
Central city office locations across Switzerland
•
Above average insurance coverage fully borne by the bank
•
Contribution to health insurance and meal allowance
•
Global growth strategy and stable environment
•
Competitive offering
About us
As a leading sustainable private bank, we offer dynamic and personalized services in investment advisory and asset management for private and institutional clients.
Our success depends on the enthusiasm and commitment of our employees and we value each person with their unique technical expertise, professional qualifications and social skills.
We are successfully operating for more than 180 years across 30 locations worldwide and offer our employees the chance to be a part of our success.
Our employees are our most valuable asset, we are proud of our unique culture that fosters entrepreneurship and is fueled by a high team spirit and
the positive attitude of each individual. Join our international team and be part of the next chapter of the J. Safra Sarasin Group.

•
Bâle, CH
•

•
Illimité
Votre rôle
En tant que spécialiste des opérations de trésorerie à la Banque J. Safra Sarasin, vous faites partie d'un environnement de groupe unique où la collaboration interdivisions nationale et internationale rencontre un impact mondial. En tant que membre clé d'une petite équipe agile, vous piloterez des opérations de trésorerie dynamiques, allant de la gestion de trésorerie, de FX, des marchés monétaires, des dépôts et des prêts et emprunts en valeurs mobilières (BVM) à la gestion des garanties. Au-delà de cela, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la sauvegarde de nos soldes de trésorerie grâce au suivi et au rapprochement précis des positions actives sur les marchés internationaux.
Vos responsabilités
• Soutien de notre principal comptoir commercial pour toutes les tâches liées à la Trésorerie
• Exécuter et gérer les opérations de garantie de bout en bout, y compris les réservations, les paiements et les rapports
• Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vie des swaps de taux d'intérêt, des swaps de devises et des swaps de défaut de crédit
• Superviser les processus de rapprochement des risques dérivés de gré à gré et fournir des rapports en temps opportun sur les contrôles réglementaires et les indicateurs opérationnels critiques aux intervenants internes
• Analyser et mettre en évidence les écarts de rapprochement non résolus jusqu ' à ce qu ' ils soient complètement réglés
• Favoriser une collaboration coopérative axée sur les objectifs avec les équipes d'opérations internes et les divisions d'affaires à travers la Suisse et les marchés internationaux
• Aider le chef de département à gérer les projets clés et les missions ponctuelles urgentes
Votre profil
• Formation professionnelle en affaires ou en économie ou apprentissage au sein d'une entreprise de services financiers
• Au moins 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Trésorerie
• Des compétences interpersonnelles saines jumelées à une motivation et une flexibilité élevées pour travailler dans un environnement passionnant, stimulant et dynamique et la volonté de contribuer à notre culture d'équipe
• Capacité d'organiser et de prioriser votre propre travail
• Affectations occasionnelles de jours fériés suisses en alternance avec des collègues de l'équipe
• Compétences en Trioptima, Markitwire et Avaloq est un avantage mais pas un must
• La maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand est requise
Vos avantages
•
Esprit d'entreprise dans une banque familiale
•
Bureaux de la ville centrale en Suisse
•
Couverture d'assurance supérieure à la moyenne entièrement supportée par la banque
•
Contribution à l'assurance maladie et à l'indemnité de repas
•
Stratégie de croissance mondiale et environnement stable
•
Offre concurrentielle
Sur nous
En tant que banque privée durable leader, nous offrons des services dynamiques et personnalisés en conseil en investissement et gestion d'actifs pour les clients privés et institutionnels.
Notre succès dépend de l'enthousiasme et de l'engagement de nos employés et nous valorisons chaque personne avec son expertise technique unique, ses qualifications professionnelles et ses compétences sociales.
Nous travaillons avec succès depuis plus de 180 ans sur 30 sites dans le monde entier et offrons à nos employés la chance de participer à notre succès.
Nos employés sont notre atout le plus précieux, nous sommes fiers de notre culture unique qui favorise l'entrepreneuriat et est alimenté par un esprit d'équipe élevé et
l'attitude positive de chaque individu. Rejoignez notre équipe internationale et faites partie du prochain chapitre du Groupe J. Safra Sarasin.

•
Full-time

Your Role
As AI Platform System Engineer at Bank J. Safra Sarasin you are strengthening our platform team as a professional and experienced engineer and provide technical engineering and operational infrastructure services to enterprise infrastructure for AI initiatives in close collaboration with several stakeholders.
Your Responsibilities
• Design and evolve scalable AI infrastructure services optimized for GPU workloads
• Implement and manage enterprise-grade AI platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenShift) for model inference
• Operate and maintain high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, including bare-metal and virtual GPU servers
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure incidents across hardware and software stacks
• Support data science teams with infrastructure provisioning
• Perform critical infrastructure tasks and participate in on-call rotations
Your Profile
• University degree (university / FH) in Computer Science
• 5 years of IT system administration experience, including 3+ years specializing in Linux (RHEL preferred) and strong scripting skills in Shell, Python, and Ansible
• Deep expertise in GPU topologies and architectures (NVLink, PCIe switching) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD). Initial hands-on experience in Prometheus, Grafana, and DCGM Exporter is required
• Familiarity with ITIL methodologies, combined with a proactive, accountable work ethic. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, effective prioritization, and the ability to deliver results under pressure
• Fluent in English; proficiency in German is a plus
Your Benefits
•
Entrepreneurial spirit in a family owned bank
•
Central city office locations across Switzerland
•
Above average insurance coverage fully borne by the bank
•
Contribution to health insurance and meal allowance
•
Global growth strategy and stable environment
•
Competitive offering
About us
As a leading sustainable private bank, we offer dynamic and personalized services in investment advisory and asset management for private and institutional clients.
Our success depends on the enthusiasm and commitment of our employees and we value each person with their unique technical expertise, professional qualifications and social skills.
We are successfully operating for more than 180 years across 30 locations worldwide and offer our employees the chance to be a part of our success.
Our employees are our most valuable asset, we are proud of our unique culture that fosters entrepreneurship and is fueled by a high team spirit and
the positive attitude of each individual. Join our international team and be part of the next chapter of the J. Safra Sarasin Group.
